gen-press-start-2p-gf-miriam-libre: Press Start 2P spaces its letters like cut-outs pinned far apart. Miriam Libre follows in a plain sans with a tall, sturdy lowercase and a wiry line, so paragraphs move along without any brush-like swelling.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Chunky and playful, Press Start 2P spaces its big-bowled lowercase like cut-outs pinned apart, while Mochiy Pop P One keeps one flat sans line weight throughout. Both stay light on their feet.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-montserrat-underli: Wide-open and unswelling, the sans-serif Montserrat Underline has round bowls that never taper and a lowercase that towers over its capitals. Montserrat Underline keeps text moving smoothly beneath Press Start 2P, whose soft-contrast curves feel playful and retro.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart and its c, s and z standing tall and full, giving a clean, contemporary body. Press Start 2P above it adds a retro grin.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-adlam-un: Retro and cheerful, Press Start 2P pins its cut-out-style letters far apart with a measured thread-against-yarn weight difference. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined settles in underneath with open curves and a sans body that barely changes height between cases.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-anatolia: Press Start 2P pins its cut-out letters far apart, with big open-looking bowls and diagonals just slightly lighter than its verticals. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs adds a sans with outward-pointing tips and a high x-height.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Press Start 2P spaces its letters like cut-outs pinned far apart, with big open-looking bowls that swell only slightly. Noto Sans Balinese gives the pair its strongest quality: a plain sans with breathing room inside every curve and short ascenders.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-bassa-va: Noto Sans Bassa Vah has a dominant midsection and an open-jawed c like a pair of pliers, which gives its plain sans lines a lot of presence. Press Start 2P brings a retro, cut-out charm.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Playful and retro, Press Start 2P pins its cut-out letters far apart, with moderate contrast in its strokes. Noto Sans Buginese answers with open letter mouths like chalk arcs left unjoined, in a modern sans-serif with short ascenders.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Noto Sans Buhid is a modern sans with generous space between its curve ends and stems, plus a high-set x-height. Noto Sans Buhid reads openly over long lines, its tall lowercase keeping every word easy to scan.
